act6/camp/manage_equip.title: Arm Against the Void
act6/camp/manage_equip.body: The light **trembles**. You reorganize what is still **yours**: weapon, armor, relics — enough for the next step.

choices.text: Return to the fire

act6/camp/use_consumable.title: Potions at hand
act6/camp/use_consumable.body: In the firelight, the flasks gleam. You choose what to drink — life, mana, or calm.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Return to camp

act6/camp/void_camp.title: Fire of Mirrored Ash
act6/camp/void_camp.body: There is no real **firewood** — only burned remains. The fire imitates warmth; your body accepts it because it must.

choices.text: Feed the flame with memory (−1 supply)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to feed the flame.

choices.text: Use a consumable
Exchange a few words with the group
Watch the gray swallow another day
choices.preview: The narrative day advances; you recover no strength.

choices.text: Manage equipment by the unstable light
Return to the fractured nave

act6/camp/void_companion_chat.title: Word by the False Flame
act6/camp/void_companion_chat.body: {{companionLine}} If you are alone, silence doubles the voice you already carry.

choices.text: Listen to Mira — voice against the echo
Listen to Tomás — shield against the void
Stand between the two — three breaths, one flame
Mira: "Fallen knight or not — here the ground does not distinguish oath"
Mira: "Honest darkness, you said once. The void charges interest"
Mira: "Penitence is weight; do not drop it now or you grow too light"
Mira: "Marksman without a banner — here even the shadow wants to know whose you are"
Tomás: "The shield reminds me of your steel — both lie that they hold everything"
Tomás: "If the void reads your journal, what remains unwritten?"
Tomás: "Faith in a place without echo — courage or habit?"
Tomás: "Arrow in the dark — do you trust the eye or the silence before the shot?"
Return to the fire

act6/camp/void_duo_fireside.title: Three Voices in the Fractured Nave
act6/camp/void_duo_fireside.body: **Mira** and **Tomás** watch the fire; no one wants to die alone here. You, {{leadName}}, stand between them.

choices.text: Choose neither — only continue

act6/camp/void_mira_fireside.title: Ash — Confidences with Mira
act6/camp/void_mira_fireside.body: > *"Here the echo lies less than people. That is not comfort — it is a **warning**."

choices.text: Ask if she still recognizes her own shadow
Speak of the end as a door, not a pit
Return to the false flame circle

act6/camp/void_mira_topic_end.title: Door or Pit
act6/camp/void_mira_topic_end.body: > *"A door closes; a well swallows. I prefer the door — I know alleys."

choices.text: Return to the unstable light
diaryTexts: Mira spoke of the end as a crack — not victory. I keep this as one keeps a match: little, but enough to see the next step.

act6/camp/void_mira_topic_mirror.title: Shadow and Mirror
act6/camp/void_mira_topic_mirror.body: > *"Shadows here have **teeth**. If you see me hesitate, do not call it mercy — call it **time**."

choices.text: Leave this reflection — return to the group

act6/camp/void_tomas_fireside.title: Ash — Word with Tomás
act6/camp/void_tomas_fireside.body: > *"This is not a camp — it is a **trial**. A trial does not ask for applause; it asks for a **step**."

choices.text: Ask if his faith sounds different here
Speak of duty when the ground promises no firmness
Return to the false flame circle

act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_duty.title: Duty Without Ground
act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_duty.body: > *"Duty needs no soil — it needs someone you will not lie to. If we fall, we fall **together**."

choices.text: Return to the group

act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_faith.title: Faith in the Void
act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_faith.body: > *"Faith does not change its sound — it changes its **echo**. If God falls silent, I still raise the **shield**."

choices.text: Leave the prayer unfinished — and return

act6/dimensional_smith/entry.title: Corridor of the Blind Anvil
act6/dimensional_smith/entry.body: A cleft cuts the nave wall. Inside: **iron**, pause, iron.

choices.text: Enter through the wall's cut and follow the sound
Return to the columns before being noticed

onEnterDiaryTexts: I heard hammer where there was no forge; the void decided to fuse something in me.

act6/dimensional_smith/forge.title: Dimensional Workshop
act6/dimensional_smith/forge.body: The workshop ceiling leans wrong — no visible fire. The smith does not smile; he measures your breath between strikes.

choices.text: Temper Iron Dagger (10 gold)
Reforge Rusty Sword (12 gold)
Forge Dimensional Ward Plate (Fracture Iron + Void Slag)
choices.lockedHint: Requires 1 Fracture Iron and 1 Void Slag.
diaryTexts: The dimensional ward plate left the forge as if it remembered my name.

choices.text: Leave the workshop

act6/dimensional_smith/unlock.title: The Forge Between Hinges
act6/dimensional_smith/unlock.body: The smith seems more noise than man. He strikes invisible metal and stops without looking at you.

choices.text: Speak. Accept the workshop's mark.
diaryTexts: The smith opened the workshop with three words and a crooked look.

choices.text: Retreat to the fractured nave

act6/encounters/memory_trial_bleed.title: Hemorrhage of Echoes
act6/encounters/memory_trial_bleed.body: You fall into the well without an axis. Old faces grip your wrists as if collecting a debt.

choices.text: Fight while memories tear you

onEnterDiaryTexts: Memories came in a pack and none asked permission.

act6/encounters/memory_trial_safe.title: Ballast of Name
act6/encounters/memory_trial_safe.body: You choose a name to pin yourself to the present. It works for a moment — long enough to face the abyss on your feet.

choices.text: Dive with the echo under control

onEnterDiaryTexts: I repeat my name as one drives a stake into a shoreless sea.

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_blades.title: The Other Name — Steel
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **mirror** ends negotiation. What remains is a shadow with teeth — and you with a **blade**.

choices.text: Fight my sovereign reflection

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_intro.title: The Other Name
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_intro.body: From the mirror steps someone with your face and stance, without hesitation. He smiles like someone who already won the argument. > *"I am you without fear.

choices.text: Take words from the reflection before steel (draft)
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation; failure leads to physical combat.

choices.text: Fight my sovereign reflection

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_resolve.title: Stitching of Shadow
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_resolve.body: The reflection unravels into black threads. They do not attack — they seek shelter along your outline. There is no clean triumph.

choices.text: Accept the fissure and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: I did not destroy my shadow. I gave it a name and a limit.

act6/encounters/reality_trial_focus.title: Coherent Fissure
act6/encounters/reality_trial_focus.body: You hold a single version of the room for a few seconds. Long enough to tell stone from reflection.

choices.text: Face the Herald with a fixed mind

onEnterDiaryTexts: I held the world by a thread of thought. I discovered thought also cuts.

act6/encounters/reality_trial_shatter.title: Fissure Without Axis
act6/encounters/reality_trial_shatter.body: The walls switch places. Your body arrives late to every gesture.

choices.text: Fight even with faith failing

onEnterDiaryTexts: When the real split, shadow entered first.

act6/encounters/void_encounter_corruptio.title: Rust That Dances
act6/encounters/void_encounter_corruptio.body: The **corruption** you carry hums in the stone. It calls shards — and a preacher who already had your name on his tongue.

choices.text: Contain the surge — stain preacher and shard drawn to the wound

act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo.title: Whispers Without Audience
act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo.body: The air thickens with ownerless voices. They recall wrong names and right dates — and laugh when you correct them.

choices.text: Endure the host until one mouth at a time falls silent

act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo_frag.title: Memory with Teeth
act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo_frag.body: The **host** repeats what you did not say; the **shard** finishes what fled your mouth. Between them, a new story forms — worse, because it closes.

choices.text: Cut the host and tear out the shard that feeds it

act6/encounters/void_encounter_fragment_.title: Decision That Remained
act6/encounters/void_encounter_fragment_.body: From the floor rises a silhouette without a stable face. It did not come from outside — it escaped you years ago and learned to walk alone.

choices.text: Face the wandering shard between the columns

act6/encounters/void_encounter_pair_frag.title: Siblings of Renunciation
act6/encounters/void_encounter_pair_frag.body: Two shadows argue in a whisper — with each other, not you — about which lie serves best. When they see you, the debate ends: you first, then the rest.

choices.text: Separate the two shards before they fuse

act6/encounters/void_encounter_penitent.title: Penitence Without Confessor
act6/encounters/void_encounter_penitent.body: Metal scrapes where no smith should be — only will tempered cold. The armor does not protect the body; it silences hesitation.

choices.text: Measure blades with the penitent of links

act6/encounters/void_encounter_shadow_ra.title: Regent Without Throne
act6/encounters/void_encounter_shadow_ra.body: For a thread of a second, the air stays with you — it does not mirror; it weighs. What moves does not ask a name: it imposes silence where you were still bargaining with doubt.

choices.text: Face the regent of broken glass head-on

act6/encounters/void_encounter_triple_fr.title: Swarm of Falls
act6/encounters/void_encounter_triple_fr.body: Three shadows rise from the same vice — not copies; versions that took body on different days. Together they take more room than one head can hold.

choices.text: Hold against the shard swarm

act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil.title: Scribe Between Dead Mirrors
act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil.body: A tall figure crosses the gloom. There is no blood — certainty drips from the veil's edges; ink where skin should be.

choices.text: Answer the scribe before he stitches sky to your throat

act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil_frag.title: Veil and Shard
act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil_frag.body: The **Scribe** traces; the **shard** obeys — not as a servant, as a living footnote to your fear. Together they close a circle that does not ask permission.

choices.text: Break the pair before the fragment becomes dogma

act6/encounters/will_trial.title: Trial of Will
act6/encounters/will_trial.body: Atop the altar, a crown of **obsidian** thorns turns. A faceless penitent holds a bladeless edge:

choices.text: Submit impulse to the altar's chance
Force direct confrontation against the penitent
choices.preview: Immediate steel — or hesitate and let the altar decide.

act6/encounters/will_trial_duel.title: Duel of the Empty Crown
act6/encounters/will_trial_duel.body: The altar chooses silence. Only the Penitent advances — each step like a word that cannot be unsaid.

choices.text: Sustain the duel and pay the price

act6/encounters/will_trial_horde.title: Crown of Hunger
act6/encounters/will_trial_horde.body: The crown splits into fragments. Each one wears one of your faces.

choices.text: Break the circle of hungry echoes

onEnterDiaryTexts: Will without bridle called versions of me that only know conquest.

act6/epilogue.title: Epilogue of the Broken Mirror
act6/epilogue.body: You carry the fractured nave in your eyes — a **shard** of mirror that still cuts the palm. Streets turn to hypothesis. The green **pulse** on the horizon did not change; how you count it did.

choices.text: Lift your eyes — the sky no longer apologizes
Close the journal for now

act6/fractured_merchant.title: Stall of the Last Price
act6/fractured_merchant.body: On a cloth that reflects nothing, flasks line up. The seller shows no hands — only prices that rise when you hesitate.

choices.text: Buy nave map (−4 gold)
Buy Red Potion (8 gold) (×2)
Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Blue Tonic (7 gold) (×1)
Buy Mead (6 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (10 gold) (×1)
choices.lockedHint: Requires 10 gold, level 32+, and prior stock already bought.

choices.text: Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the stall

act6/hub_fractured_nave.title: Fractured Nave
act6/hub_fractured_nave.body: Three corridors leave the **nave**: reality, memory, will. The **Void** opens only one at a time. Cracks cut the dark overhead.

choices.text: Patrol the fractured nave (explore map)
choices.preview: Move between columns and ruins; stress rises and the void may answer.

choices.text: Follow the corridor of broken mirrors (Trial of Reality)
choices.preview: First cord: reality; permanent mark according to outcome.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 26 for the first cord; once the trial is complete, the corridor no longer opens here.

choices.text: Descend to the bottomless memory pit (Trial of Memory)
choices.preview: Only after the real: memory; echo leaves a mark.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 26+ and completing the Trial of Reality first.

choices.text: Climb to the altar of bare will (Trial of Will)
choices.preview: Last trial before the mirror; will measured or split.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 26+ and completing the Trial of Memory first.

choices.text: Cross the Inner Mirror Gate
choices.preview: Three trials done; the final mirror opens.
choices.lockedHint: Three trials, map goal, and level 31 — the mirror does not open early.

choices.text: Light the fire of mirrored ash (camp)
choices.preview: A breath of supply and broken silence.

choices.text: Trade with the forgotten stall merchant
choices.preview: Remedies and prices in gold or promise.

choices.text: Seek the Dimensional Smith
choices.preview: Few words, much metal, and exact charge.

choices.text: Listen to the whisper beneath the columns (corruption route)
choices.preview: Pact in the void; requires high corruption and level.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 31+, corruption 4+, and the Trial of Reality completed.

act6/litany_after_memory.title: Litany of Fleeing Names
act6/litany_after_memory.body: The choir tunes down to a silence that is not peace — it is **waiting**. Memory here is rope, not archive.

choices.text: Climb without looking back — the pit has eaten enough

act6/litany_after_reality.title: Litany of Cut Reality
act6/litany_after_reality.body: The columns repeat your step a tone lower. The real already bit.

choices.text: Accept that the next throat only speaks when this one falls silent

act6/litany_after_will.title: Litany of the Empty Crown
act6/litany_after_will.body: The circle of dust around your feet closes. Three trials, three bites on the same body.

choices.text: Return to the esplanade — the final mirror demands the three marks

act6/memory_after.title: Ballast of Memory
act6/memory_after.body: The choir dissolves into dark ink drops that rise instead of fall. Each drop brings a face you loved and did not save.

choices.text: Climb back to the fractured nave

onEnterDiaryTexts: My memories are not archive. They are battlefield.

act6/memory_trial.title: Trial of Memory
act6/memory_trial.body: In the well, you see scenes of your own life in layers. When you try to touch one memory, another wakes beneath it.

choices.text: Hold a name on your tongue before diving
choices.preview: Without anchor in time, the pit drinks without asking.

choices.text: Fall into the pit without ties

act6/mirror_gate.title: Inner Mirror Gate
act6/mirror_gate.body: The nave's three marks shine together. The floor opens an arch. Beyond it, a room without doors.

choices.text: Enter and face who inhabits me

onEnterDiaryTexts: I passed the three questions and none absolved me.

act6/nave_summons.title: Chorus Before the Queue
act6/nave_summons.body: The columns order themselves without moving. You will not choose everything at once — you cross one at a time, and each leaves a scar. A faceless choir rehearses your name in three tones.

choices.text: Climb to the esplanade where only one trial breathes at a time

onEnterDiaryTexts: The Void does not open a menu — it opens a queue. Three throats, one at a time, as if time here were rope and not clock.

act6/opening_void_threshold.title: Void Threshold
act6/opening_void_threshold.body: The ice **opens** under the Heights. Below, a **nave** without an altar — stone and night, no true door. Echo returns late, in your voice with another intent.

choices.text: Enter the fractured nave and hear what remains of the world

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the bottom of the ice was a door without hinge. I entered and the world answered with my voice, but without my mercy.

act6/reality_after.title: Scar of the Real
act6/reality_after.body: The herald's mask cracks. Behind it there is no flesh — only void with your breath in it.

choices.text: Let the chorus answer and return to the esplanade

onEnterDiaryTexts: Truth did not free me. It only took my right to lie to myself.

act6/reality_trial.title: Trial of Reality
act6/reality_trial.body: The mirrors show you with easier choices — you never entered the Dungeon, or you were loved by all and forgotten by all. The herald tilts his head: *real is what **insists***.

choices.text: Try to fix a single world with the mind
choices.preview: Without fixing in time, the veil splits.

choices.text: Close your eyes and accept collapse

act6/void_secret_claim.title: Mark of the Hollow Blade
act6/void_secret_claim.body: The mirror touches your chest from inside. A dark line remains over the sternum, hot as freshly forged metal.

choices.text: Return to the fractured nave with the mark active

onEnterDiaryTexts: I learned a new creed: bleed to wound better.

act6/void_secret_entry.title: Vein of the Abyss
act6/void_secret_entry.body: The columns draw apart without moving. Between them a corridor of wet stone appears — angles the eye refuses.

choices.text: Follow the corridor that does not exist on the map
Listen for metal in the vein — the trail that does not fade
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: Retreat before the void recognizes you

onEnterDiaryTexts: Corruption opened a door lucidity did not see.

act6/void_secret_pact.title: Liturgy of the Fissure
act6/void_secret_pact.body: An opaque mirror rises from the floor and writes your name with your own shadow. The offer is simple: turn pain into strength, turn after turn.

choices.text: Accept the pact and carve the seal into the body

act6/will_after.title: Oath Without Witnesses
act6/will_after.body: The penitent falls to his knees, but does not bleed. He spreads black dust that writes a circle around your feet.

choices.text: Descend to the fractured nave

onEnterDiaryTexts: Will is not strength to defeat everyone. It is discipline not to obey the worst in me. The amulet of the trials pulses — a ward against heat you have not yet seen.
